verdict.rationale: YPOG's own pages describe transactional IP advice: building up and realizing IP assets, IP-driven VC/PE deals and joint ventures, and NFT-related IP issues. Nothing in the pack describes litigating patent, trademark or trade-secret disputes, and no courts, venues or outcomes are named. Advisory and transactional IP work is adjacent to this story and earns no credit for litigation.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages
